_comment: Calibrated 2026-08-03 against the live mini store: 2.05 GiB of session data accumulated in 15 days (~140 MiB/day), of which ~76% is FTS5 shadow index. root.max_bytes counts session databases only (default state.db plus profiles/*/state.db and their WAL/SHM sidecars), not the whole Hermes home. prune_after_days x growth.expected_bytes_per_day must stay <= root.max_bytes or the operator refuses to load this policy.
